data.name: Jaheem
data.gender_notes: Jaheem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gathers, or the one who is gathered (in knowledge or in faith). The name Jaheem carries the meaning “Gatherer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jaheem usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to be a gatherer of knowledge and wisdom, or a child who is believed to be gathered (protected) by God
data.etymology: Jaheem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaheem total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جهيم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جهم يعني النار الشديدة الحرارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جهيم مشتق من جهم و هو يعني النار الشديدة الحرارة، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كوصف للنار، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني قوية و صعبة، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تطلق على الذكور في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: جہیم
in_urdu.meaning: جہیم کا مطلب ہے شدید گرمی والی آگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جہیم نام عربی زبان کے جہم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شدید گرمی والی آگ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں نار کے وصف کے طور پر آیا ہے۔ یہ نام ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو سخت اور مشکل معانی رکھتے ہیں، اور بعض اسلامی ثقافتوں میں ذکروں کو دیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जेहिम
in_hindi.meaning: जेहिम का अर्थ है अत्यधिक गर्मी वाली आग
in_hindi.long_meaning: जेहिम नाम अरबी भाषा के जहीम से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अत्यधिक गर्मी वाली आग। यह नाम कुरआन में नर्क की आग के वर्णन के रूप में आया है। यह उन नामों में से एक है जो कठोर और कठिन अर्थ रखते हैं, और कुछ इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में पुरुषों को दिया जाता है।

in_english.name: Jaheem
in_english.meaning: Jaheem means intense heat or fire
in_english.long_meaning: Jaheem is derived from the Arabic root 'jahama', meaning intense heat or fire. It is mentioned in the Quran as a description of hellfire. This name carries strong and challenging connotations, and is used in some Islamic cultures as a name for boys. The etymology of Jaheem is rooted in Arabic linguistics, reflecting a sense of powerful and intense heat.
